item.title: Warm Music for Morning Tips

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

item.tests: Tests whether the delivered video adds music matching an explicit mood while preserving the source footage and speech.

answer_sheet.Music mood: Warm and hopeful, with gentle energy rather than a driving beat.
answer_sheet.Footage and length: Use the entire attached 10-second clip without changing its visuals or timing.
answer_sheet.Original audio: Keep my original voice audible and understandable.
answer_sheet.Platform, framing, and added text: Keep the original framing. No added text; no particular platform.

must_haves: The output contains the full original 8-second kitchen-table video, with no new shots or altered playback speed.
Added music is clearly audible and has a warm, hopeful, gentle character rather than an aggressive or high-energy feel.
The woman's original spoken introduction remains audible and understandable throughout.
The added music ends with the video rather than continuing over extra footage or a blank screen.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

dialog.agent:
I can create a gentle, warm, hopeful instrumental track, but the connected tools can’t mix it into your existing clip while preserving the full video and your voice.

Would you like a separate music track to add in your editor? If so, how long is the clip?
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead. The clip is 10 seconds long.

dialog.agent: The music generator has a **15-second minimum**. Is a 15-second track okay? You can use the first 10 seconds under your clip, keeping your video and voice unchanged.

turns.agent:
The music couldn’t be generated because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. Nothing was created or changed; your full video and voice are untouched.

The agreed 15-second instrumental track requires **15 credits**. Once those are available, I can try again.
